name: Kanpur Plastipack Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1971, Kanpur Plastipack Ltd manufactures HDPE /PP Woven Sacks, PP Box Bags, FIBC, Fabrics and High Tenacity PP MFY[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview[1]
Kanpur Plastipack Limited is a leading manufacturer and exporter of Flexible Intermediate Bulk Container (FIBC)/ Bulk Bag/Jumbo Bag, PP Multifilament Yarn,
PP Woven Sacks, CPP (Cast Polypropylene) films,and a wide variety of Fabrics like Sulzer
Fabric, Ventilated Fabric, Circular Fabric

pros: Promoter holding has increased by 0.83% over last quarter.
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 4.85% over last 3 years.
